prompt: Which statement is true regarding the NFSv4 pseudo file system on the NFS server?
choices: It is defined by the option `Nfsv4-Root` in `/etc/pathmapd.conf`
It usually contains bind mounts of the directory trees to be exported
It must be a dedicated partition on the server
It usually contains symlinks to the directory trees to be exported
explanation: The NFSv4 pseudo file system typically uses bind mounts to assemble the exported directory trees under a single root.
